text: Maria’s fascination with history and the lessons it holds drives the thematic structure of her novel, 'Whispers of the Past', by framing the narrative around archaeologists uncovering an ancient civilization. This plot device allows her to explore themes of time, continuity, and change, illustrating how the past continuously shapes the present and future. The author’s motive to highlight the enduring influence of history is thus structurally embedded in the story’s focus on excavation and discovery, serving as a metaphor for understanding the present through the lens of the past.
